selected_skill.page_contract: 学习者应理解同样的 1 km² 网格中居民越多，三维地形越高，因为俯视颜色、倾斜高度和侧视峰值都由同一人口字段直接编码。
selected_skill.lost_information_if_flattened: 读者将无法同时看到人口高度、峰脊遮挡和最高网格相对外围低密单元的垂直关系。

chars.scope: author-layer only; frozen chassis, population evidence and vendored Three.js are excluded

readability_changes: Named the elevation scale and grid center once so the height and placement algorithm reads as one canonical mapping.
Destructured stable cell tuples into id, column, row and population at each algorithm boundary instead of repeating numeric indexes.
Kept copy, camera views, color stops, fallback aggregation and semantic entity IDs explicit rather than compressing them into opaque tables.
Removed only CSS declarations already guaranteed by the frozen chassis, including duplicate reset, hidden and reduced-motion behavior.
Kept scene construction, camera transition, render annotation and disposal ownership in separate named functions.
Validated public view names before canceling the authored camera sequence, and release the global API when its owned scene is disposed.

camera_equivalence.verification: Baseline and candidate position, up, quaternion and projection matrices were deeply equal for all three named views.

tests.name: formal archive immutability
tests.evidence: All three author and four runtime-asset SHA256 values match the recorded baseline manifests.

tests.name: syntax and population model
tests.evidence: node --check passed; the model test verified metadata, bounds, positive integer populations, 4,732 unique stable IDs, sum, maximum, peak placement, elevation scale and 93-column fallback aggregation.

tests.name: geometry, color, identity and renderer
tests.evidence: Instrumented baseline and candidate produced identical instance matrix, instance color and entity-order hashes, identical BoxGeometry parameters, shadow flags, scene child order, draw calls, triangles, lines and warm renderer memory.

tests.name: named cameras
tests.evidence: Top, tilt and profile position, up, quaternion and projection arrays are exactly equal.

tests.name: fixed-state pixels
tests.evidence: The saved cross-audit harness compared baseline/candidate top, tilt and profile at 1600x900, tilt at 1280x720 and reduced-motion profile. The final run measured pixel AE=0 for all five states and paired it with exact DOM, camera, renderer, matrix, color and entity hashes.

tests.name: content and data mapping
tests.evidence: The initial copy, three view explanations, legend, peak value, 4,732-cell count and 14,807,951 total are unchanged and backed by the same frozen data.

tests.name: mouse, touch and keyboard
tests.evidence: Mouse click, touchscreen tap and focused-button Enter each entered the expected transitioning state and settled on the same named view in baseline and candidate.

tests.name: resize and clipping
tests.evidence: 1600x900 and 1280x720 preserve the 1600x900 logical canvas and render size; visible copy, controls, legend, annotation and source have no scroll overflow or bounds escape.

tests.name: reduced motion
tests.evidence: Reduced motion opens directly in the decisive profile view with no transition; its baseline/candidate frame is AE=0.

tests.name: reset and invalid view
tests.evidence: An invalid public view no longer cancels the pending authored sequence: after three seconds it reaches tilt. Double reset returns the same top frame (final run pixel AE=0).

tests.name: fallback and context loss
tests.evidence: The saved harness forcibly denies WebGL and verifies the authored 93-column population profile has painted pixels, unchanged population-height copy and profile state. The previous report's context-restoration assertion was not backed by a saved test and is no longer claimed here.

tests.name: dispose, pagehide and reinitialize
tests.evidence: Explicit dispose makes a retained handle inert, disposes all owned geometries/materials plus the renderer/context exactly once, clears ready and releases window.PopulationScene. Fallback pagehide also releases its API; reload recreates one #gl canvas, one authored fallback canvas and a fresh ready API.

tests.name: runtime errors and resources
tests.evidence: Normal, interaction, reduced-motion, resize, fallback, pagehide and reload paths reported zero page errors or failed requests. The forced WebGL-denial path emitted only Three.js's single expected context-creation diagnostic; no unexpected console errors occurred.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Shorten identifiers or minify author code.
unadopted_compression.reason: Directly conflicts with Agent readability and the explicit no-minify constraint.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Pack copy, camera views and continuous color stops into positional tuples.
unadopted_compression.reason: Would save modest characters but hide semantic field names that an Agent must learn from.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Remove entity IDs, the fallback aggregation, named views, shadows, annotations or lifecycle paths.
unadopted_compression.reason: Each carries spatial evidence, visual parity, accessibility or resource ownership and would be a quality regression.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Regenerate, quantize or downsample the population field.
unadopted_compression.reason: Would alter the evidence, instance matrices, color mapping or stable data identity.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Count frozen chassis, data or vendored Three.js as author-layer compression targets.
unadopted_compression.reason: They are shared or evidentiary runtime assets, are symlinked unchanged in staging and should not be rewritten for token optics.

risks.risk: The staging candidate relies on relative symlinks to formal runtime assets.
risks.mitigation: Every target and hash is recorded; promotion must preserve or materialize the same paths deliberately.

risks.risk: WebGL screenshots depend on deterministic driver output.
risks.mitigation: Pixel evidence is paired in the same Chromium environment and independently reinforced by exact matrices, colors, camera transforms and renderer metrics.

notes: The formal archive was not edited and the candidate was not promoted.
The modest author-layer reduction is intentional: the existing core was already dense, while the remaining large files are frozen evidence, chassis and vendor assets.

findings: The original report had no saved browser harness, so its pixel, input, fallback and lifecycle assertions were not independently reproducible.
dispose() left window.PopulationScene retaining the entire disposed scene closure.
The public setView wrapper canceled the automatic camera sequence before validating its input, so an invalid view caused a hidden state mutation.
The earlier context-restoration and fixed-transition-frame claims were not covered by the persisted tests and were removed rather than repeated.
staging_fixes: Release window.PopulationScene only when it still points to this scene's API.
Validate a public view name and disposed state before clearing automatic camera timers.
Persist a 52-check Playwright harness with fixed screenshots, model/geometry hashes, real mouse/touch/keyboard input, reset, reduced motion, fallback, disposal, pagehide and reload coverage.
